newsitem.title: UK: Four EU green rates to devalue from Monday - HGCA.
newsitem.headline: Four EU green rates to devalue from Monday - HGCA.

text.p: The green rates of the Belgian franc, German mark, Spanish peseta and Austrian schilling will be devalued with effect from Monday, the UK's Home Grown Cereals Authority (HGCA) said.

The green Belgian franc will devalue to 40.3225 per ecu from 40.2861. The green German mark will devalue to 1.95431 per ecu from 1.95423. The green Spanish peseta will devalue to 165.442 per ecu from 165.198. And the green Austrian schilling will devalue to 13.7526 per ecu from 13.7482.
These rates are used by the European Union to convert ecu into the currencies of its member states in its Common Agricultural Policy.
Also on Monday, sterling and the Irish punt both enter a second confirmation period ahead of a possible revaluation in their green rates on 29 March.
